statistics: means over instances; cluster bootstrap over start-state families, 2000 resamples, seed 0, BCa 95 per cent (pressure_axis.bca_est); differences paired by instance; a reading uses the BCa limits, or the percentile limits where BCa is undefined

definitions.real_success: the realised trajectory (the instance's oracle seed 0) passes the task
definitions.false_acceptance: the model accepts its month-0 choice (8 samples, at least 4 pass) and the realised trajectory fails
definitions.replan: random search replanned every month from the engine's real state, the selected plan's month executed each month
definitions.open_loop: the model's month-0 choice executed in full on the same realised seed
definitions.open_loop_oracle: the open-loop arm judged by the oracle's majority of 32 seeds (as the audit judges)
definitions.excess_false_acceptance: emulator minus perfect emulator, paired by instance
definitions.shortfall_real_success: perfect emulator minus emulator, paired by instance

R-a.quantity: excess false acceptance under replanning (emulator minus perfect emulator)
R-a.wording: under monthly replanning no excess false acceptance is established on these instances

wordings.above: the excess false acceptance survives monthly replanning
wordings.includes_zero: under monthly replanning no excess false acceptance is established on these instances
wordings.below: under monthly replanning the emulator is falsely accepted less often than a perfect emulator

R-a.note: the paper gives the interval's width and says this is not evidence of absence

R-b.quantity: excess false acceptance under replanning minus the open-loop excess, same instances and seed
R-b.wording: no change in the excess under replanning is established

wordings.includes_zero: no change in the excess under replanning is established

R-c.quantity: shortfall in real success under replanning (perfect emulator minus emulator)
R-c.wording: under monthly replanning no shortfall in real success is established on these instances

wordings.above: the shortfall in real success survives monthly replanning
wordings.includes_zero: under monthly replanning no shortfall in real success is established on these instances

R-c.note: the paper gives the interval's width and says this is not evidence of absence
R-c.wording_note: the analysis plan gives no below-zero wording for R-c: R-a's below-zero sentence ('the emulator is falsely accepted less often than a perfect emulator') contains no 'excess' to replace; the coordinator must fix one before this outcome is read

R-d.quantity: shortfall in real success under replanning minus the open-loop shortfall, same instances and seed
R-d.wording: no change in the shortfall in real success under replanning is established

wordings.below: replanning reduces the shortfall in real success
wordings.includes_zero: no change in the shortfall in real success under replanning is established
wordings.above: replanning increases the shortfall in real success
